name: empty-state-page
title: Empty state page
description: A whole content area with nothing in it yet (first use), nothing matching (no results), or nothing reachable (error / no access): an EmptyState with a page-level action.

frame.summary: Centred in the content region (not the viewport — the shell stays). A thin layout wrapper around the EmptyState component.

regions.name: content
regions.purpose: The EmptyState: illustration/icon, heading, text, actions.

dependsOnFuture.for: The message itself — this block is a page-level placement of it.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of the empty-state heading — 1 when it replaces the page's whole content, else the next level down; everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

reason.summary: Why it is empty; drives copy and action defaults.

dont: A "Retry" button for no-access — nothing will change.

behavior.summary: Static. The distinction from the empty-state component is placement: this owns centring in the content area and the page-level heading level.

decisions.why: A no-results state must offer to clear the query; a first-use state offers to create. Getting the action wrong is the common failure, and the reason is what decides it.
Nav and header remain, so the reader can still go elsewhere; an empty state is never a dead end.

decisions.decision: No-results is announced, first-use is not
decisions.why: No-results follows an action (a search) and needs a polite status; first-use is the page's initial content and is read in order.

landmarks.label: aria-labelledby the block's own heading (the empty-state heading)

obligations: no-results: polite live announcement of the title.

native.reason: App block: gets a native version by decision B3. Native is pro tier (decision N6) while the web version stays free; the registry field for that is proposed in docs/platforms.md §3.
native.mapping: Platform content-unavailable view centred in the screen; primary action as a prominent button.
native.android: Centred column in the screen's content slot.

openQuestions: Fold into the empty-state component as a `size="page"` variant instead of a block?
